question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The ancient **sconce **held a flickering torch along the corridor.

options.text: The thief smashed the wall sconce and fled.
The student was sconced for violating tradition.
The bronze sconce was engraved with floral motifs.
The hallway featured a new LED sconce.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"sconce"** in the context of the sentence refers to a bracket fixed to a wall for holding a candle or torch. (दीवार पर लगा हुआ मोमबत्ती या मशाल रखने का ब्रैकेट) • **Example:** The antique sconce in the living room was a family heirloom. • The homonym of "sconce" is also a term used to describe a penalty or fine imposed on a student for a breach of college rules or traditions. (छात्र को परंपरा या नियम तोड़ने पर लगाया गया जुर्माना) • **Example:** The rowdy student was sconced for his disruptive behavior during the lecture. • Hence, the sentence in Option 2, "The student was sconced for violating tradition," uses the homonym of the word "sconce" in a different context. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: The thief smashed the wall sconce and fled.** This sentence refers to a "sconce" as a wall fixture for holding a light or torch. (दीवार पर लगा हुआ प्रकाश उपकरण) • **Example:** The wall sconce gave the room a warm and inviting glow. • **Option 3: The bronze sconce was engraved with floral motifs.** This also uses "sconce" in the sense of a decorative wall bracket for lighting. (दीवार पर लगा सजावटी प्रकाश उपकरण) • **Example:** The designer chose a bronze sconce to match the vintage decor. • **Option 4: The hallway featured a new LED sconce.** This sentence again refers to a "sconce" as a lighting fixture. (दीवार पर लगा हुआ एलईडी प्रकाश उपकरण) • **Example:** The LED sconce illuminated the dark corner of the hallway perfectly. 42:Tad6, The correct answer is '**where the book was kept**'.
